purpose: Settings fixed before the one-time holdout run (2023-Q4..2024-Q3). Both quality variants are reported regardless of results.

holdout.reporting: per-quarter results emphasised; with four quarters, no fold-level confidence intervals

models.calibration: Platt (sigmoid on log-odds) fitted on the validation quarters
models.preprocessing: fold-fitted: 1st/99th percentile caps, median imputation + missing indicators, categories >= 0.1% else 'other', standardization for logistic regression

best_rule_basis: highest mean AP on the primary (retain) development folds

host_aggregation.value_ranking: sum over listings of p_i * V_i
host_aggregation.dedup: host at t, across markets, per quarter

contact_timing: earliest decision_date among the host's eligible listings in the quarter

value_proxy.definition: 12-month gross booking value at asking price; bookings from reviews per 30 days
value_proxy.price: missing -> neighbourhood x room median at the quarter's prediction dates, then city x room; capped at the quarter's p99

metrics: net benefit and break-even cost per contact
